text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM. Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages with their dock door assignments. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and the contact at Quarrendon confirmed the next morning's shift got through the gate fine.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated). It's described there as gate barcode scanners not reading trailer tags at Door 14. The note says it was passed to second-line support to test the scanner firmware.

I also warned Dana that Marcus's July 2025 handoff note gives #4419 a different description: slow printing at Gate 3. One of the two notes is wrong, so I suggested checking with Marcus or Support before it goes in the weekly notes.

I left out ticket numbers that belong to Central team accounts. I also left out Quarendon Freightways (one "r"), which is a different company and not a customer.

Everything I used is in public team folders or Marcus's public notes, all of which Dana can open. I didn't read any channels or messages that Dana can't see.
